title: Har Kishan v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Vikram D. Chauhan, J.
disposition: Writ withdrawn with liberty to avail Electricity Act, 2003 and Supply Code, 2005 remedies.
headnote: The Allahabad High Court disposed of Har Kishan's writ as withdrawn. After brief submissions the petitioner sought withdrawal with liberty to pursue remedies under the Electricity Act, 2003 and the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Counsel for the electricity department did not object. The Court allowed the prayer and granted that liberty. No Supply Code or Act question was decided on the merits.
facts: Har Kishan invoked the writ jurisdiction of the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and three others. The electricity department appeared through counsel. After making brief submissions, the petitioner's counsel asked to withdraw the petition, seeking liberty to pursue remedies under the Electricity Act, 2003 and the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Counsel for the electricity department had no objection to that prayer.

holding_units.topic: withdrawal with liberty to Act and Supply Code remedies
holding_units.holding: On the petitioner's prayer, and without objection from the electricity department, the writ petition was disposed of as withdrawn with liberty to avail the remedies provided under the Electricity Act, 2003 and the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court did not examine the merits of the electricity dispute.

principle_tags.application: Where the consumer prays to withdraw an Article 226 petition and the licensee does not object, the Court may dispose of the writ as withdrawn with liberty to pursue remedies under the Electricity Act, 2003 and the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, without deciding the underlying supply dispute.

not_decided.point: merits of the petitioner's electricity grievance
not_decided.note: Petition withdrawn; no adjudication under the Electricity Act, 2003 or the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
